description: This file defines the HeaderDefinition interface, describing the structure for header definitions in the Ditto project, including methods for retrieving header key, types, serialization, and validation.

classes.name: HeaderDefinition
classes.description: An interface that specifies the contract for a Ditto header definition, including methods for key retrieval, type information, serialization, header externalization policies, and validation.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the header key used as the map key, which must be lower-case.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type of the header value.

methods.name: getSerializationType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type used for serializing the header value.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether Ditto reads this header from external sources.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternalHeaders
methods.description: Indicates whether Ditto publishes this header to external sources.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates whether the provided CharSequence is a valid representation of the header value based on its Java type, potentially throwing DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the header definition key.
